decision.observation: The goose faces east on clear grass; the green cup is visible to its right near the hedge, still beyond lowered-beak reach.
decision.hypothesis: A short move onto the grass just west of the cup should preserve the goose's eastward facing and bring the cup within pickup range.
decision.memory: The cup is not held. Re-aim after camera movement, then bend and grab only when the cup is directly ahead at close range.
